name: Ford
role: Helena freighter with a mule outfit
bio: Ford ran a freighting outfit of twenty wagons and seventy-five mules that came from Helena to Medora in June 1884. In July he took loads at Belfield for $1.50 rather than stand idle.

moments.label: Freighting outfit reported on its way from Helena
Accepted $1.50 rate for freighting from Belfield

mentions: Ford's freighting outfit is on the way here from Helena. It is composed of twenty wagons and seventy-five mules.
